responsibility: Provides the instruction scheduling automaton for Intel Atom in-order cores within the i386 backend. It defines Atom-specific execution attributes, port and execution-unit reservations, instruction-class latencies, and many explicit bypass rules for address-generation, flag, multiply, shift, and SSE dependencies, so GCC’s scheduler can model Atom’s dual-pipe in-order issue behavior rather than the out-of-order behavior described in neighboring core-specific .md files.
